<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def piece_pos(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    for c in range(17,43):
        if a[20][c]=='b' and a[20][c+1]=='b':
            return c
    return None
def grid_state(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    def arm(r0,r1,c0,c1):
        return ''.join(sorted(set(a[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1))))
    return (arm(49,51,29,31),arm(59,61,29,31),arm(54,56,24,26),arm(54,56,34,36),arm(54,56,29,31))
# green T, B, L
for click in [(50,30),(60,30),(55,25)]:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':click[0],'col':click[1]}])
print("after 3 arms: grid=",grid_state(current_frame),"piece_c=",piece_pos(current_frame))
# sweep piece right, checking each slot
for i in range(6):
    r=action(['RIGHT'])
    p=piece_pos(current_frame); g=grid_state(current_frame)
    print(f"RIGHT#{i+1}: piece_c={p} grid={g} lc={r.get('level_completed')} done={r.get('done')}")
    if r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done'): break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
